column1: # Exact Gradle-managed tooling components which are resolved outside project lock states.
# Human-readable evidence, hashes, provenance boundary and upgrade decision:
# The component/artifact counts are asserted in build.gradle.kts (parseDetachedToolingManifest:
# entries.size == 15, artifactCount == 28) so that any drift in the AGP/KSP tooling graph fails
# the build instead of silently widening the audited surface.
# REGENERATION (required whenever the AGP or KSP anchor in gradle/libs.versions.toml changes,
# even for a patch bump, because the lint/AAPT2 transitive set may change):
#   2. Resolve the new tooling with verification recording so Gradle writes the real hashes:
#   3. Diff gradle/verification-metadata.xml and list every component that has no lock-state
#      owner (task-created/detached selections: AAPT2, KSP embeddable processor, AGP lint stack
#      and its transitive tooling). Those are the components that belong in this manifest.
#   4. Update the rows below to the exact resolved versions and the exact artifact names present
#      in the regenerated verification metadata (one SHA-256 per artifact, no ranges/SNAPSHOTs).
#   5. Update entries.size / artifactCount and the AGP/KSP anchor checks in build.gradle.kts to
#      the new reviewed counts, then re-run:
#   6. Review the diff: a changed count is a supply-chain change and needs a human decision,
